description: Call this first, always. It shows each question as a picker, one at a time, and returns the answers. Each picker has the option "Type my own answer". It sends nothing. If it returns paused: true, call it again with the picker_id it gave you, right away, until it returns completed or stopped. If it returns elicitation: false, ask the questions from get_questions in chat.

picker_id.description: Leave empty to start. To continue a paused picker, pass the picker_id from the last result.

name: ask_with_picker
title: Ask with pickers
